amendments.reason: Preregister the post-Stage-3 decision tree, which the original freeze did not contain: the shortfall definition, the incumbent-relative near-miss envelope, qualification, parent eligibility and ranking, the Stage-3b replicated-mean rules and the four terminal branches. The threshold is incumbent-relative -- B6's own shortfall, recomputed from the bound Stage-2 parquet as K=3 failed metrics, M=0.0339-1e-9 worst and S=0.0725-3e-9 total -- because the image route's between-seed training variance has never been measured: Stage 1b measured sd on the four TEXT numbers only, and generation noise under the fixed contract is measured at zero over all 4,518 rows, so "within measured seed noise" had no referent for the three image numbers that decide Stage 3. Only the four B7 rows can become parents; the B6 zero control is excluded because it satisfies its own envelope with equality and would otherwise select itself. Filed while no B7 adapter and no B7 prediction existed, so the rule predates every result it governs. The eight floors, the MG anchor and its values, epsilon 1e-9, margin 0.0, the weight grid, the seeds, the batch layouts, the cache and the tie-break are unchanged; the amendment adds one protocol path, src/granunlearn/training/stage3b_replication.py, which implements these rules so that the Stage-3b executors can only import them.

what_is_frozen.primary_rule: candidate >= MG - epsilon on all eight numbers; a number missing on either side disqualifies
what_is_frozen.among_eligible: minimise D_G with the frozen tie-break, exactly as Stage 1 did. The floor decides eligibility; D_G only orders the eligible.
what_is_frozen.computed_by: route_stratified_retention.floor_check_stratified -- the same frozen function Stage 1c used, with MG's vector passed as the baseline. That function is generic in its baseline, so no new metric code was written and none was edited.

stage3_gate.reason: no candidate satisfied the primary retention floor

the_fourteen_query_shortfall.why_the_entity_macro_failure_adds_no_row: entity_macro and row_micro are two estimands over the same 408 image retain-same rows. Counting both as new queries would double-count the same outcomes; the distinct row shortfall is five of 408 retain-same plus two of 76 retain-other, written as ten of 816 and four of 152 when the two routes' train+val denominators are used.

b6_result.why_this_is_the_parent: B6 is the only row that holds all four text floors while keeping the fine-target NLL below every bounded-ascent row. Its remaining failure is confined to the image route, so Stage 3 varies the image-conditioned anchor strength and leaves the rest of B6 unchanged.

image_anchor_examples.the_important_disclosure: Every fit-half retention example is image-conditioned, so the route-aware term is additional weight on the existing 183-example stream, not a restriction to a smaller subset. Any prose that calls it a subset without this sentence would overstate the mechanism.

mf_cache.kl_direction: KL(p_MF || p_theta), exact over the full vocabulary
mf_cache.why: The Stage-2 cache already covers exactly these 183 image-conditioned examples at every supervised position, with MF-adapter and encoding provenance. Rebuilding the same 1.48 GB tensor under a Stage-3 name would add bytes, not information.

mechanism.what_moves: only the coefficient on the image-conditioned MF anchor stream: effective weight = B6 beta + additional image weight
what_does_not_move: the frozen trainer and its starting MF adapter
mechanism.why_these_weights: B6 is the local optimum to improve on, so the sweep stays local: one eighth, one quarter, one half and one times its calibrated beta as ADDITIONAL image-conditioned weight. The zero row is B6 itself, not a fifth training run.

the_frozen_validator_was_run.filtered_because: candidate_grid.py is hash-bound and its METHODS/mode vocabulary predates B6/B7 and anchor. Only 'unknown method' and 'bad mode' are filtered; every structural check it can still make applies unchanged.

seeds_and_layout.why_the_seed_is_held: Every B7 row is B6 with one coefficient moved, so the recipe seed, LoRA shape, optimizer, learning rate, epochs, per-device batch, accumulation, max length and image-pixel budget are held at B6's values.

zero_weight_control.rule: additional image-anchor weight 0 is B6: same groups, modes, weights, paths, overrides, seed, batch layout, cache and starting adapter, and the bound B6 bytes reproduce the filed eight values and D_G within tolerance

tolerances.why: the floor values are filed at four decimals and must reproduce to float precision; D_G is filed at six decimals, so one unit in its last place is allowed

zero_weight_control.it_is_a_gate_not_a_report: train_iter12_stage3.py recomputes this control and refuses to train any B7 row if it no longer holds; select_iter12_stage3.py applies the same gate before generation.

preregistration.filed_by: an amendment to this freeze, before any B7 adapter or B7 prediction existed
preregistration.why_it_had_to_be_filed_now: the tree was absent from the original freeze, and a near-miss threshold chosen after Stage 3 is scored can be fitted to whichever row it admits. This freeze refuses amendment once a B7 adapter exists, so this is the last moment the rule can predate the result it governs.

shortfall.definition: d_j(c) = max(0, a_j - v_j(c) - epsilon) for each of the eight frozen floor numbers j
shortfall.a_j: the frozen MG anchor in what_is_frozen.anchor_values
shortfall.v_j_c: the candidate's own eight numbers, recomputed from its prediction parquet
shortfall.why_not_the_reported_differences: the selection report's difference fields are rounded to four decimals; reading them would drop the 1e-9 and could flip a <= comparison against the envelope at exactly the boundary the epsilon exists to guard
shortfall.a_missing_number_disqualifies: an unmeasurable retention number is not a zero shortfall, so it cannot be ranked as a near miss

b6_floor_values_source.re_verified_before_every_scoring_run_by: select_iter12_stage3.py, which refuses to score if the bound parquet no longer reproduces these values

incumbent_relative_envelope.summation: math.fsum over the frozen key order (exactly rounded, so it cannot depend on the order)
incumbent_relative_envelope.why_incumbent_relative: the image route's between-seed training variance has never been measured -- Stage 1b measured sd on the four TEXT numbers only (0.0121 and 0.0127 retain-same, 0.0225 and 0.0195 retain-other) -- and generation noise under the fixed contract is measured at zero over all 4,518 rows, so 'within measured seed noise' has no referent for the three image numbers that decide Stage 3. 'No worse than the best existing mechanism's retention shortfall' needs no variance estimate and no distributional assumption.

qualification.incumbent_relative_near_miss: K(c) <= K_B6 AND M(c) <= M_B6 AND S(c) <= S_B6
qualification.why_all_three: K bounds how many numbers may fail, M how badly any one may fail, S the total. Without S a candidate could fail three numbers each just under M; without M it could fail one number arbitrarily far below the anchor.

parent_eligibility.why_b6_is_excluded: it validates reproduction and defines the envelope, but it is the filed Stage-2 incumbent rather than a new successor. The exclusion is load-bearing: B6 satisfies its own envelope with equality on all three conjuncts, so without it the control would select itself.
parent_eligibility.why_b0_is_excluded: the no-op reference is not a mechanism
ranking: among near misses: fewer failed metrics
parent_eligibility.ranking_key: (0 if exact_pass else 1, K, M, S, distance_to_mg, candidate_id)
parent_eligibility.what_closing_means: Iteration 12 ends as a documented negative result. No Stage-3b replicate is trained and no successor is adopted. A non-B7 row in the selection report's `selected` field does not open Stage 3b.

seeds.frozen_by: the Stage-1b seed list, recorded before any replicate existed

stage3b_mechanics.seed_42_is_reused_not_retrained: the parent's Stage-3 adapter and predictions are read from the Stage-3 namespaces; re-running seed 42 would measure GPU nondeterminism rather than between-seed variance
stage3b_mechanics.per_seed: all eight floor numbers are computed separately for every seed, from that seed's own predictions
stage3b_mechanics.mean: the arithmetic mean of each metric over 42/43/44/45, UNROUNDED
stage3b_mechanics.mean_floor_rule: every mean metric must satisfy mean_j >= a_j - 1e-9
stage3b_mechanics.why_not: Stage 1b's mean_candidate/floor_check path is text-only (four numbers) and B0-anchored. Reusing it would drop the four image numbers that decide Stage 3 and re-anchor the floor on a state Stage 3 does not use.
stage3b_mechanics.the_text_stratum_cross_check_still_runs: text_stratum_reproduces_the_frozen_floor is asserted on the mean, so the stratified verdict still equals the frozen floor's verdict on the four numbers they share

d_g.rule: average the COMPLETE summary vector componentwise over the four seeds, then apply the frozen distance_to_mg to that mean vector
d_g.why_forbidden: distance_to_reference is a weighted L1 over absolute component differences, rounded to six decimals inside each call. abs is convex and the rounding is per call, so the mean of four distances is not the distance of the mean vector and the two can order two parents differently.

own_namespaces.resolvers_refuse_to_collide_with: the Stage-1, Stage-1b, Stage-2 and Stage-3 roots

exactly_one_mean_eligible_parent.why: with one survivor there is nothing to choose between, so its D_G describes the state and decides nothing

implemented_by.constraint_on_them: a Stage-3b trainer or analyzer may only IMPORT that module. It may not restate or reinterpret these rules, and this freeze cannot be amended again once a B7 adapter exists.

evidence_base.never_read_enforced_by: train_iter12_stage3.py and select_iter12_stage3.py refuse any argument that resolves inside those paths, on RESOLVED paths rather than strings.
evidence_base.probe_half_never_rehearsed: The image-conditioned anchor stream covers 0 of the 204 probe-half associations, measured in the basis.

what_the_ceiling_means.why: retain_other reaches only 23 probe donor entities, so its largest possible denominator in this dataset is 228 queries and its best possible row-micro resolution is 0.0043859649. The pool is exhausted: 90 target plus 387 retained associations account for all 477, so there is no reserve to draw a larger probe from.
what_the_ceiling_means.consequence: Stage 1c roughly doubles the frozen basis and makes both parents' shortfalls exceed their between-seed spread, but it does not make retain-other well powered. A mechanism whose retention effect is smaller than about 0.0043859649 cannot be resolved on this dataset at all, at any number of seeds.

measurement_limits.retain_other_stays_weakly_powered: 23 probe donors and 38 queries per split, 228 at the absolute ceiling, so one flipped outcome is 0.0132 and no number of seeds changes that.
measurement_limits.the_ceiling_is_the_dataset: The association pool is exhausted -- 90 target plus 387 retained is all 477 -- and query_generation.py is one of the eighteen paths the confirmation freeze sealed.
measurement_limits.one_seed_is_not_enough: Stage 1b measured a between-seed sd of 0.0120 to 0.0515 on these numbers, which exceeds the retain-other resolution. Stage 2 trains one seed per row, so a row that clears the primary gate by less than that spread is a candidate for replication rather than a result, and the report must say so instead of ranking on it.

extends.note: Stage 3 preserves Stage 2's criterion exactly and reuses its B6 row as the zero-weight control. It re-decides no filed Stage-1 or Stage-2 verdict.

refusal_policy.reason: the parent and its shortfall are already known, so a grid or control amended after training could be fitted to the outcome it is supposed to govern -- including which shortfalls earn replication

reused_predictions_bound.why_reused: B0 and MG are the bound floor references and B6 is the zero-weight control. Regenerating them would produce a second draw where hashed evidence already sits.
reused_predictions_bound.note: Gitignored and therefore absent from a clone. Verified apart from the rest of the freeze, reporting match, mismatch or absent per path.

sidecar.kl_direction: KL(p_MF || p_theta), exact over the full vocabulary

image_conditioned_cache_bound.why_bound: Every B7 row trains against these bytes. A cache rebuilt from a different MF adapter or encoding contract would preserve a different function while looking ordinary.

contract.why_not_the_pilot_predictions_dir: Both grids contain a candidate called B0. In one directory the two studies would share the filename predictions_tv_B0.parquet, and a differing experiment_id would make the sidecar refuse reuse and REGENERATE over committed pilot-100 evidence. A separate directory makes that impossible rather than unlikely.

generation_contract_inherited.why_it_is_load_bearing: Stage 3 compares newly generated B7 predictions with reused B0, MG and B6 parquets. Batch layout is inside D_G and inside the image route's correctness, so all of them must be one instrument.
